name: kessoku-ultimate-bocchi
description: Kessoku Ultimate Bocchi Theme: a Bocchi the Rock!-inspired charcoal-and-pink skin for all of Claude Code (an engine theme plus every render site), a live Kessoku Band panel with the band on stage as animated pixel-art sprites under spotlights and their subagents as songs on a setlist (solo any member) and band subagent types Claude can delegate to by name, a recap card when a long set ends and a per-project tour across sessions (/bocchi stats), and themed Cache Tax, Blast Radius, Filetree, Reflect and Replay Theater gags.

applyTheme.title: Kessoku engine theme
applyTheme.description: Offer to switch Claude Code's theme to the Kessoku Bocchi theme (prompt border, diffs, status colors, everything the engine draws); /bocchi theme on|off changes it later

transcriptSkin.title: Transcript skin
transcriptSkin.description: How much of the transcript the band restyles: full (messages, tool groups, turn footer, hint line, question dialog), light (only the small lines: footer, hint, notices), or none

characterArt.title: Character art
characterArt.description: How the band is drawn: sprites (animated pixel art, rendered with Remotion: the live-house stage and animated pictures in the desktop app, block-character pixels in a terminal) or kaomoji (the text faces, and the panel's text layout). Text-only spots (status line, toasts) keep the kaomoji either way

restyleOthers.title: Restyle other mods
restyleOthers.description: Give other mods' panels pink borders and theme text where they left colors unset (a ui.resolve hook; off leaves their looks alone)

toasts.title: Toasts
toasts.description: Which band toasts to show: all (every subagent on and off stage), important (the guard, commits, the theme, a cold cache), or none. The native notifications (the guard holding a command, a long set done, the cache about to go cold) and the recap card at the end of a long set follow it: none under none

accent.title: Accent color
accent.description: Accent for borders and highlights: a theme key such as claude (follows the active theme), a hex color, or a terminal color name

paintBackgrounds.title: Charcoal backgrounds
paintBackgrounds.description: Paint dark charcoal backgrounds behind the theme's own panels and cards (skipped automatically on a light theme)

toolCards.title: Tool row cards
toolCards.description: Which tool rows get a stylized pink border: every tool call, only file edits, or none

spinnerWords.title: Band spinner words
spinnerWords.description: Swap the spinner's verb for band-themed ones that follow what the turn is doing (terminal only)

cacheTtlMinutes.title: Cache TTL (minutes)
cacheTtlMinutes.description: Prompt-cache lifetime Cache Tax assumes when the engine has not said: 60 for a subscription session, 5 for a plain API key

keepWarmMinutes.title: Keepwarm default (minutes)
keepWarmMinutes.description: How long /keepwarm keeps the cache warm when given no duration

reflect.title: Reflect memos
reflect.description: Let Nijika turn your corrections into CLAUDE.md rules (one tiny Haiku call per correction), and let Claude propose one itself through the memo tool; you press Save either way

openPanelOnStart.title: Panel on start
openPanelOnStart.description: Open the Kessoku Band panel when the session starts, where the terminal is wide enough for a sidebar

autoSolo.title: Auto solo
autoSolo.description: When a member takes a new subagent, open her channel across the panel's mixer (her solo) for ten seconds, then return to the mix; a solo you chose yourself is never cut short
